# Bundled libraries

All are MIT licensed and copied unchanged from npm.

| File | Package | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `jszip.min.js` | jszip 3.10.1 | Making .zip downloads |
| `heic2any.min.js` | heic2any 0.0.4 | Opening iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos |
| `utif.js` | utif 3.1.0 | Opening TIFF files |
| `pako_inflate.min.js` | pako 2.1.0 | Compressed TIFF support |
| `ag-psd.js` | ag-psd 31.0.2 | Opening Photoshop PSD files |
